entries.zh: 起初；事情之始、刚开始的时候
entries.en: at the very beginning; at the start of a matter

entries.zh: 前頭，前面、前头；先前（末字辨读存疑：悖/惇）
entries.en: in front, at the front; previously (third character uncertain: 悖/惇)
entries.notes: 末字悖/惇两读与音写 chuen 皆不完全吻合，本义据汉字“前頭”定为“前面／先前”。

entries.zh: 前起，先起、起在前头（末字辨读存疑：悖/惇）
entries.en: to rise or begin first, beforehand (third character uncertain: 悖/惇)
entries.notes: 末字悖/惇存疑；“前起”据汉字与音写 cheng quy 定为“先起”。

entries.zh: 前時，先前；早前的时候
entries.en: formerly; in earlier times

entries.zh: 在先，先前；事先、起先
entries.en: beforehand; previously; at first

entries.zh: 唱始，倡始；发端、首倡其事
entries.en: to initiate; to begin, to take the lead in starting

entries.zh: 倡首，首倡；带头发起
entries.en: to take the lead; to originate, to head (a cause)

entries.zh: 始初，初始；开头
entries.en: the outset; the very beginning

entries.zh: 創始，创始；开创其端
entries.en: to originate, to found; inception

entries.zh: 頭起，起初、开头（末字辨读存疑：悖/惇）
entries.en: the beginning; the start (third character uncertain: 悖/惇)
entries.notes: 末字悖/惇存疑；“頭起”据汉字与音写 tau quy 定为“起初／开头”。

entries.zh: 頭初，起初、开头（末字辨读存疑：悖/惇）
entries.en: at the very start; the beginning (third character uncertain: 悖/惇)
entries.notes: 末字悖/惇存疑；“頭初”＝起初，义与西语 principio 相合。

entries.zh: 巔裡，顶端、极高之处；末字或作“理”，若为“天理”则义为本原、天理，与西语 principio 之“原理”义相合
entries.en: the very top, summit; if the second character is 理, possibly “heavenly principle” (first principle) — sense partly uncertain
entries.notes: 末字裡/理两读存疑；音写 tien ly 与“天理”吻合，或为原词，暂并记两解。

entries.zh: 原初，原始；本初、起初
entries.en: the origin; the very beginning, primeval state
entries.notes: [疑:guan/quan] 仅涉音写首音清浊，汉字“原初”明确，义项不受影响。

entries.zh: 立春，节气名；春季之始（岁首节气）
entries.en: Beginning of Spring, the first solar term of the Chinese year
entries.notes: 西语栏 principios del vera(no) 似作“夏之始”，与立春不合，汉义以汉字栏为准。

entries.zh: 無采頭，没彩头；不走运、无利可图，开场不利
entries.en: no luck, no gain; an unlucky start or bad omen
entries.notes: 西语栏 mal aguero（凶兆）与“無采頭”相合；malcaumen 疑为原词音之讹写。

entries.zh: 開年，开年；新年伊始、岁首
entries.en: the opening of the year; the beginning of the (new) year

entries.zh: 正月，农历岁首之月；元月
entries.en: the first month of the lunar year; New Year month

entries.zh: 振起，兴起；奋起、振兴
entries.en: to rise up; the rise or revival of something

entries.zh: 首尾，头尾；始末、来龙去脉
entries.en: beginning and end; the whole matter from start to finish

entries.zh: 巔末（同“颠末”），始末；事情从头至尾的原委
entries.en: the whole course of an event; beginning and end
entries.notes: 末/朱两读中音写 buan 合于“末”（朱不合）；“颠末”＝始末，义与西语 principio y fin 相合。

entries.zh: 威實；据西语栏当为“善始、吉始”之义，汉字确解存疑
entries.en: 威實: literally “awe and solidity”; per the Spanish column, a good beginning — exact sense undetermined
entries.notes: 音写 oy/uy fit 与“威實”读音不合，语义无法定夺，降为低置信。

entries.zh: 唱采；据西语栏当为“善始、有彩头”类吉语，汉字确解存疑
entries.en: 唱采: per the Spanish column, an auspicious/good start (lucky omen) — exact sense undetermined
entries.notes: 音写 hua 与“唱”（当读 chiang 类）不合，汉字与音写对应存疑，语义无法定夺。
